initial_web_attempt.explanation: The added reload assertion initially expected a below-9999 wallet after game start. Existing Demo._start refills the playtest wallet at every start. The final test verifies the exact persisted charge and single receipt before Start, then preserves the existing startup refill; product economy was not changed.

scope: Serial fresh-profile recovery only; normal save protocol, corrupt byte backup, game rules and render behavior unchanged.
